card.market_crash.tip: Sectors move in cycles: when demand slows, income dips for a while. Owning assets across several families softens the blow.
card.good_harvest.tip: A good season doesn't always repeat itself: many people set the surplus aside for leaner years.
card.equipment_breakdown.tip: Equipment wears out: that's why businesses keep a maintenance reserve, or take out breakdown cover.
card.property_fire.tip: Property insurance costs a small regular premium to avoid a rare, large expense. You're paying for peace of mind.
card.medical_bill.tip: Health costs never give notice. Health cover or a small emergency fund saves you from selling an asset in a hurry.
card.harvest_loss.tip: Farming depends on the weather. Crop insurance pools that risk: many pay in, and those who are hit get compensated.
card.tax_refund.tip: A tax refund is often money you overpaid during the year coming back. Keeping your paperwork in order can pay off.
card.price_spike.tip: When prices rise, the same money buys less: that's inflation. Income-producing assets help you keep pace.
card.market_boom.tip: Boom times happen too, but they don't always last. Today's extra income is no guarantee for tomorrow.
card.training_leave.tip: Training is investing in yourself: a new skill can raise your income for a long time.
card.community_grant.tip: Many public and community programmes support small businesses. They ask for paperwork, but you don't pay them back.
card.transport_repair.tip: A working vehicle wears out fast. Budgeting for maintenance avoids nasty surprises.
card.energy_surcharge.tip: Energy bills follow world prices. Cutting consumption is a saving that repeats every month.
card.crop_bonus.tip: After an exceptional harvest, income rises across the whole sector for a while. Landowners benefit.
card.rent_revision.tip: Rereading and renegotiating your contracts now and then is often easy money.
card.health_check.tip: Prevention costs a little now to avoid paying a lot later. Health cover pays part of it.
card.local_levy.tip: Local contributions pay for the roads, markets and shared services your business also uses.
card.supply_contract.tip: A regular customer makes income more predictable, and predictable income reassures the bank too.
card.storm_damage.tip: Natural disasters are rare but costly. That's exactly the kind of risk property insurance takes on.
card.market_recovery.tip: Markets often bounce back after a dip. Those who held on instead of selling at the bottom reap the gains.
card.family_care.tip: Helping family is part of life. Leaving some slack in your budget lets you do it without borrowing.
card.fuel_saving.tip: A recurring saving is as good as income: 10 saved every month is like earning 10 more.
card.business_dispute.tip: A clear written contract is cheap to draft and prevents plenty of disputes.
card.renewable_credit.tip: Public policy can make a sector more profitable overnight. Following the news helps you spot those waves.
opportunity.discounted_property.tip: Buying cheaper boosts your return: the same income for a lower price is a better investment.
opportunity.small_subsidy.tip: A subsidy is a free boost. Put into an earning asset, it keeps working for a long time.
opportunity.business_partner.tip: A good partner brings customers or skills you don't have. You share the gains, and the risks too.
opportunity.skills_training.tip: At first, your safest income is often your work. Growing it gives you more room to invest.
opportunity.cooperative_order.tip: Teaming up in a cooperative lands orders too big for any one person.
opportunity.equipment_lease.tip: An idle item can earn: renting out equipment you're not using is a small passive income.
opportunity.microgrant.tip: Micro-grants often target projects that are just starting. The hardest part is knowing they exist.
opportunity.export_contract.tip: Selling abroad opens bigger markets, but you have to handle exchange rates and payment delays.
opportunity.shared_workspace.tip: Cutting a fixed cost works every single turn, for good. It's often more powerful than a one-off gain.
opportunity.digital_upgrade.tip: A good tool saves time, and saved time can go into selling more.
opportunity.community_tender.tip: Public tenders pay well and steadily, but you have to meet precise specifications.
opportunity.market_stall.tip: A good spot means foot traffic, which means customers. In retail, location matters as much as the product.
opportunity.solar_rebate.tip: Some rebates refund part of an investment that already lowers your bills. A double win.
opportunity.new_client.tip: More customers also means less reliance on a single buyer: your income gets sturdier.
opportunity.business_course.tip: Knowing how to read a budget or a margin leads to better decisions, and it shows in your income.
opportunity.repair_voucher.tip: A voucher is only a saving if you were going to spend the money anyway. This time, you were.
